value.latest: Please note that this is actually two lanes of traffic going in the direction currently delineated. If both lanes could be added it would be helpful because only the left lane goes left underneath the freeway. The right lane actually gets on the freeway. This would keep Cars from trying to turn from the far right lane in a leftward manner under the freeway. Thank you.

There’s actually a freeway offramp here so they really should be three lanes illustrated. Where I dropped the pin should be flowing in the same direction as the interstate meaning going south. This is important because some of the self driving software is taking you right up the interstate off ramp against traffic because I believe it is seeing the Northwood going Lane that is adjacent. Therefore if the exit off of the interstate is delineated with the correct flow of traffic I think it would correct this potentially catastrophic error for self driving
